title.en: TaN, Ta and Cu seed have distinct roles

subtitle.zh: 同在Cu之前，但阻挡、界面和导电任务不能互换
subtitle.en: All precede Cu, but their barrier, interface and conduction tasks are not interchangeable

body.zh: Low-k / ILD；TaN（扩散阻挡层）；Ta（界面衔接层）；Cu Seed（导电种子层）；ECP Cu（主体填充）
body.en: Low-k / ILD TaN (diffusion barrier) Ta (interface transition layer) Cu seed (conductive seed layer) ECP Cu (bulk fill)

body.zh: TaN |挡住Cu；阻止Cu向介质扩散，；关键是连续无针孔
body.en: TaN | block Cu Prevent Cu diffusion into the dielectric; continuity without pinholes is crucial

body.zh: 2；Ta | 接好界面；改善TaN到Cu Seed；之间的界面衔接
body.en: 2 Ta | connect interfaces Improve the interface transition between TaN and Cu seed

body.zh: 3；Cu Seed；接通电流；为电镀提供连续；导电与起镀表面
body.en: 3 Cu seed Connect the current path Provide a continuous conductive surface for electroplating initiation

body.zh: 4；ECP Cu |；完成填充；形成互连的主体；导电体积
body.en: 4 ECP Cu | Complete the fill Form the main conductive volume of the interconnect

body.zh: Ta界面异常；附着 / 接触异常
body.en: Ta interface defect Adhesion / contact anomaly
Cu seed break Local plating does not start / void

body.zh: 经典层栈可简记：TaN挡、Ta接、Seed导、ECP填
body.en: Classic stack shorthand: TaN blocks; Ta connects; seed conducts; ECP fills

body.zh: • 具体材料与命名会随技术节点和整合方案变化
body.en: Specific materials and names vary with technology node and integration scheme
